# Accessibility Checklist: Standalone pages for doncoleman.ca

**Purpose**: Validate that WCAG 2.2 AA requirements for the standalone pages are complete, measurable and consistent.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Heading Structure

- [x] CHK001 - Is "exactly one main heading" defined for every page type, including the Home card (name as h1) and pages with a feature image? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK002 - Are heading-level rules defined for section titles (text block, offerings list items) so levels never skip or repeat h1? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the required heading-colour behaviour for content headings specified against the design system, in both themes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK004 - Is it specified whether the draft notice is a heading, a landmark or plain text, so it does not disturb heading order? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015]

## Images and Alternative Text

- [x] CHK005 - Is "meaningful alternative text" for Don's photo defined with criteria distinguishing it from decorative or empty alt? [Clarity, Spec §US2-1]
- [x] CHK006 - Are alternative-text requirements consistent across the feature image, sharing image, captioned, wide and full-width images? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the relationship between a caption and its image defined (semantic association) rather than only visual proximity? [Clarity, Spec §US4-4]
- [x] CHK008 - Is a decorative-image case addressed (explicit empty alt versus required text)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [x] CHK009 - Are the gradient border and any decorative card elements excluded from the accessible name or information content? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## Colour Contrast

- [x] CHK010 - Are contrast minimums (4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text and UI components) stated for the ported hero card in both themes? [Measurability, Spec §US1-3, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK011 - Are contrast requirements stated for prose-accent styles (body text, links, blockquotes, code, list markers) in both themes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 - Is contrast for the gradient border against both theme backgrounds specified where it conveys the card boundary? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK013 - Are contrast requirements defined for the lead section, offerings list and draft notice colours in both themes? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK014 - Is link identification not reliant on colour alone specified for prose links? [Gap, WCAG 1.4.1]

## Focus and Keyboard

- [x] CHK015 - Is a visible focus indicator (with minimum contrast and size) specified for the Home call to action and every call-to-action section? [Measurability, Spec §US4-3]
- [x] CHK016 - Are focus-state requirements defined for the GitHub and LinkedIn links in the card, consistent with the footer's? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK017 - Are focus-not-obscured and target-size (24px minimum) requirements addressed for social icons and calls to action? [Gap, WCAG 2.4.11, 2.5.8]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the keyboard reading and tab order of the Home card (photo, heading, bio, social links, call to action) specified? [Gap, Spec §US2-1]

## Landmarks and Navigation

- [x] CHK019 - Are landmark requirements (one main, header, footer, labelled nav) specified for the shared page layout? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the current-page indicator for navigation defined for assistive technology, not only visually? [Clarity, Spec §US1-6]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the offerings list required to be a semantic list, and is the same required for any other grouped items? [Clarity, Spec §US4-2]
- [x] CHK022 - Are the social links' accessible names stated as identical to the footer's? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]

## Responsive and Robustness

- [x] CHK023 - Are reflow requirements (320px, no two-dimensional scrolling) defined for wide and full-width images and long titles? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 - Are text-resize and zoom (200% and 400%) requirements addressed for the card and prose layouts? [Gap, WCAG 1.4.4, 1.4.10]
- [x] CHK025 - Is the document title and language requirement stated for every page built from a page file? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK026 - Does "no automated accessibility violations" name which rule set and which pages/themes are in scope, and acknowledge what automated checks cannot cover? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §FR-028]
